original.target_description: Experiment 1 spatial-orientation performance: unresolved overall condition main effect versus condition comparisons within females/males.

notes: Document identity verified from title, authors and DOI 10.1177/0956797616667459 in supplied canonical text. No PDF was supplied. Only assigned unfinished fields examined; other fields/sides are placeholders. Candidate tests, all p. 1511: overall condition main effect F(1, 131) = 16.84, p < .001, partial eta-squared .11, d = 0.67; female social/spatial contrast t(68) = 5.08, p < .001, d = 1.22; male social/spatial contrast t(63) = 0.27, p = .79 (no d printed for this simple comparison). The broad social-versus-spatial description does not identify the overall or sex-specific contrast. Candidate sample sizes from explicit final groups on p. 1508: overall factorial model 65 + 70 = 135; male-only 32 + 33 = 65; female-only 34 + 36 = 70; spatial-only 33 + 36 = 69; social-only 32 + 34 = 66. Four below-chance participants excluded before these final counts. These are candidates only; none is assigned as target analytic N. Canonical printed t(60) for the spatial sex comparison is preserved without repairing it or inferring N from df.
